// This fixture holds a spec go/parser accepts and a type checker would not:
// two names, one value. It reaches the length half of the walk's readability
// test, `len(vs.Values) != len(vs.Names)`.
//
// A compiler would refuse this file, which is exactly why nothing else can
// screen that clause: internal/graph cannot hold the shape. The walk parses
// without type-checking, so it can be handed one — and without the length
// test it would index the second name into a one-element value list.
package graph

// PropertyType is the type whose constants the walk collects.
type PropertyType string

const (
	TypeString PropertyType = "STRING"

	// Two names, one value.
	TypePair, TypeSpare PropertyType = "PAIR"
)
